title: Listening field

techniques.name: Presence field

state.label: Presence
state.note: Mir’s state, drawn as the wave through the field: rings from the center, diagonal waves reaching out, or a low swell.

pitch.label: Dot pitch
pitch.note: Spacing of the dot lattice, in screen pixels, held at any plate size as on the page. The page’s own is 5.

dot.label: Dot size
dot.note: Side of each square dot as a share of the lattice pitch; the page’s 1.7 px on its 5 px lattice is 34 %. At rest prints at 0.6 of it, as the page does.

freq.label: Wave number
freq.note: How many crests cross the field. 35 is the page’s ring count; Reaching and At rest scale their waves with it.

cover.label: Coverage
cover.note: A dot prints where the hash falls under (wave + 1) × this. Higher fills the crests in; lower leaves only their peaks.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-deals which lattice points print. 0 is the page’s own hash.

techniques.implementation: A square-dot lattice thresholded by a fixed hash against a wave: dot printed where hash(x, y) < (wave(x, y, t) + 1) · coverage. The wave is the state: sin(35·r) from the center; sin(20·(x + y)) · cos(20·r); or sin(12·x)·sin(6·y)·0.35.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.
